references.text: Moses was commanded to seek the Lord's will through the priest Eleazar and the Urim. This shows the right way to seek God's guidance, in contrast to Israel's leaders who did not ask the Lord.
Proverbs urges us to trust in the Lord with all our heart and not rely on our own understanding, but acknowledge him in all our ways. Israel's leaders failed by relying on their own judgment.
Isaiah warns against making plans without asking the Lord. Israel's leaders in Joshua 9 acted similarly by making a covenant without seeking God's counsel.
David asked the Lord before going to battle against the Philistines. This stands in contrast to Joshua's men, who did not ask the Lord before making a covenant with the Gibeonites.
Jehoshaphat prayed that the word of the Lord might be sought before they went to war. This shows the importance of seeking God's guidance in important decisions.
James encourages us to pray to God for wisdom. Israel's leaders lacked this wisdom because they did not ask the Lord.
